name: Gothic II: Gladiator
storyline: At the behest of the current King, Rezenhart, Proxemo has ordered his men to raid nearby settlements and capture people who will then be slaughtered by local gladiators in the arena. One of these is Romulus, the sole survivor of the slaughtered village of Maranda, whose main goal has become revenge against the king. Luckily he comes across an ally at the beginning of his journey...
summary:
A total-conversion modification by OrtegaX & Damianut & Gladiator Team referring to the game Sword&Sandals, the axis of which are tournaments taking place in the successive arenas of the kingdom of Panamat.

Features:
- about 20 hours of gameplay
- dozens of fights to the death on four arenas
- original soundtrack composed exclusively for the mod
- polish dubbing
- original script solutions
- many new models, textures, sounds and items
